entries.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
entries.desc: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

entries.title: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
entries.desc: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.
